controls_requested_for_future_discussion.when_enabled: Reveal Correction value (deg) and an Add (+) / Subtract (-) selector.
controls_requested_for_future_discussion.value: User supplies a finite nonnegative magnitude. Zero is valid. Use the separate operation selector for the sign; reject negative magnitudes to avoid double-negative ambiguity.
controls_requested_for_future_discussion.when_disabled: Apply no correction. Retained inactive settings must not affect processing.

deferred_changes.uniform_correction_definition: theta_corrected = theta_measured + s * magnitude_deg, where s = +1 for Add and -1 for Subtract. Apply the effective signed correction once, from immutable original angles, to every acquired row in the raw dataset, including signal and background scans, independently of temperature, field or position. No per-scan/T/B variation and no accumulation on reprocess.
deferred_changes.endpoint_requirement: User objected to discarding selected endpoints after a shift. Example: with a -3 degree correction, originally selected positions 0 and 200 degrees must still be reported as -3 and 197 degrees. This is an illustrative requirement, not a supplied calibration value.
deferred_changes.rounding_request: User asked for positions rounded to the nearest digit. Exact precision and rounding semantics have not been agreed; do not introduce new rounding in v1.3.
deferred_changes.superseded_proposal: The earlier proposal filtered against unchanged numeric bounds after shifting and could discard selected endpoints. The user rejected that behavior. It is not an accepted future design.
deferred_changes.constraints: Preserve original measured tokens/raw files and identities; any future correction is user-provided, uniform across signal/background rows, applied once, and distinct from torque zero adjustment. No actual probe-error magnitude is supplied.
deferred_changes.open_questions: Resolve endpoint retention, selection/correction order and requested reporting precision when the user revisits the feature; no implementation or migration scaffolding in v1.3.
